test_gravity_compensation: test gravity compensation by comparing MuJoCo and PyBullet inverse dynamics for a Franka Panda robot
set_robot_attributes: set robot joint position, velocity, and acceleration then step the MuJoCo simulation forward
get_link_idx: get the link index for a named link in a PyBullet robot simulation
pybullet_env_fixture: create a PyBullet simulation environment with a Franka Panda URDF robot and zero damping
joint_states: generate random joint position, velocity, and acceleration states for a 7-DOF robot
